summary: Application for turning drawing revision packages into reviewable, client-facing change evidence and deliverables, with CloudHammer_v2 as the active revision-cloud detection/eval/training subsystem.

commands.name: check-processes
commands.purpose: Check ScopeLedger backend processes, port listener, services, and Cloudflare Tunnel status.
commands.expected: Prints backend processes, listeners, matching Windows services, and cloudflared tunnel processes.

commands.name: start-active-dev
commands.purpose: Start the active local development app on port 5001 without touching the handoff tunnel.
commands.expected: Starts the backend at http://127.0.0.1:5001/projects and writes process output under logs/.

commands.name: stop-active-dev
commands.purpose: Stop the active local development app on port 5001.
commands.expected: Stops repo-rooted backend processes matching port 5001 and reports status.

commands.name: reset-project-registry
commands.purpose: Clear the app project registry without deleting workspaces or source packages.
commands.expected: Reports the number of cleared app project registrations and registry path.

commands.name: fast-release-smoke
commands.purpose: Verify the main app handoff path without live CloudHammer or GPT processing.

commands.name: full-test-suite
commands.purpose: Verify ScopeLedger app tests and legacy CloudHammer unit tests from a repo-level command.

services.name: scopeledger-dev
services.role: Active local development backend/review app for the main repo.

notes: Command Center project registry membership is manual from Settings by repository path; this manifest does not register the project by itself.
The frozen Kevin/client handoff runs from a separate clone on port 5000; this active repo normally uses port 5001 for development.
CloudHammer_v2 is the active eval-pivot detection subsystem. Frozen real eval pages must not enter training, mining, relabeling, tuning, synthetic backgrounds, or future mining.
The manifest uses the provisional Command Center V1 shape and should be reviewed when the final schema lands.
priorityRank is intentionally unset because no explicit numeric rank was source-grounded.
The previous long-form docs/CURRENT_STATE.md was archived at docs/archive/docs_archive_2026_06_07/docs_folder/CURRENT_STATE.md before replacing it with the Command Center pulse structure.
